typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFile as string (),
	ArchiveFileName as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	CallList_Code as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),
	TimeStamp as string ()
}

source(output(
		MemberNum as string,
		Phone as string,
		Branding as string,
		CustomUse as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(FileIID = $File_IID) ~> AddFileId
AddFileId derive(CustomUse_NonUnicode = CustomUse,
		MemberNum_NonUnicode = MemberNum,
		Phone_NonUnicode = Phone,
		Branding_NonUnicode = Branding) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID as long,
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_EXTRADATA as string,
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_EXTRADATA1 as string,
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_MEMBERPHONE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID = FileIID,
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = MemberNum_NonUnicode,
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_EXTRADATA = Branding_NonUnicode,
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_EXTRADATA1 = CustomUse_NonUnicode,
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_MEMBERPHONE = Phone_NonUnicode)) ~> OLEDBDestination
